messages:
Sophie L: FYI customer acme-corp flagged a mismatch between their GCP Marketplace invoice and our dashboard for March. Invoice shows 12,340 marketplace units, Redwood usage dashboard shows 10,120 tokens. They're asking for a refund/clarification. invoice id: INV-GCP-2026-03-9876. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/invoices/INV-GCP-2026-03-9876

Kevin T: can you paste the raw line item(s) from the invoice? need SKU, unit price, aggregated quantity. also which customer_account_id are we mapping to? @Sophie L

Sophie L: pasted CSV excerpt below (redacted):
```
InvoiceID,LineItemID,SKU,Quantity,UnitPrice,ChargeDate,ProjectID
INV-GCP-2026-03-9876,LI-3245,Marketplace:LLM-Inference,12340,0.0005,2026-03-31,projects/marketplace-12345
INV-GCP-2026-03-9876,LI-3246,Marketplace:SupportFee,1,50.00,2026-03-31,projects/marketplace-12345
```

Sophie L: our internal usage export (same month):
```
customer_id,reported_tokens
acme-corp,10120
```

Maria C: rough math — invoice quantity 12,340 vs our 10,120 = delta 2,220 units. Could be a mapping issue (marketplace account vs subaccount). Do we have any overlapping marketplace resellers for acme?

Kevin T: pulling metering logs now. command: `billing.dump --customer acme-corp --range 2026-03 --source marketplace`

billing-bot: Started export job job-8891 for `billing.dump --customer acme-corp --range 2026-03 --source marketplace`. ETA ~45s.

Kevin T: results: total_marketplace_metered = 12340 entries (matches invoice). total_redwood_recorded = 10120. Top contributor: project/marketplace-12345: 12340. Our mapping table shows acme-corp -> marketplace-account 67890, not 12345. So marketplace account mismatch.

Sophie L: ah — customer claimed they had two integration attempts, one with marketplace account 12345, then we updated mapping to 67890 on 2026-03-15. Looks like GCP billed all month to 12345.

Danny B: possible root cause: we apply usage attribution by marketplace_project_id at ingestion time. If mapping changed mid-month, some events may still reference old project id and were billed on invoice to the old marketplace account. We need to reconcile which tokens correspond to acme and whether those 12345 tokens should be attributed to acme-corp in our system for billing purposes.

Maria C: can we run a query to re-attrib tokens with project id 12345 to acme for March, but mark them as "post-hoc attributed - invoice verified" so accounting knows to issue credit?

Kevin T: quick query snippet I ran: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_metering WHERE project_id='projects/marketplace-12345' AND time >= '2026-03-01' AND time < '2026-04-01'` -> 12340. Also `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM redwood_usage WHERE customer_id='acme-corp' AND time >= '2026-03-01' AND time < '2026-04-01'` -> 10120. So yes, difference entirely from project 12345.

billing-bot: Note: invoice INV-GCP-2026-03-9876 applied a promotional credit GCREDIT-ACME-300 on 2026-03-20 for -$150. That credit is on the invoice but not reflected in marketplace line items (credits are separate).

Sophie L: customer says they saw the credit but overall they were still charged more than expected. They want either a customer credit or we bill them the difference depending on who is at fault.

Kevin T: proposed immediate actions:
1) Re-attribute metering records for project 12345 to acme-corp for March as a one-time reconciliation (keep original ingestion metadata).
2) Create an accounting adjustment record and notify Finance to issue a credit for the overcharge amount (delta * unit_price).
3) Patch mapping workflow to ensure marketplace-project -> customer mapping changes are backfilled for 7 days by default.

Maria C: agree. Also include audit trail: record `original_project_id`, `new_customer_id`, `reconciliation_reason=marketplace_mapping_update`. I'll open the reconciliation PR and include sample SQL.

Danny B: I'll start a support case with GCP billing (case link TBD) to confirm invoice owner for project/marketplace-12345 and ask if they can reissue a corrected invoice if mapping error is on their side.

Sophie L: customer update: "thanks, please keep me posted, we need this resolved before end of month for our internal finance close." :worried:

Kevin T: I'll enqueue the re-attribute job now: `billing.reattribute --from-project projects/marketplace-12345 --to-customer acme-corp --range 2026-03 --note 'manual reconciliation'`

billing-bot: Re-attribute job job-8902 queued. Estimated time 2m.

gcp-invoice-bot: FYI invoice owner lookup: projects/marketplace-12345 -> GCP account 12345 (external marketplace partner). Contact: marketplace-support@acme-gcp-partner.example.com.

Maria C: tagging @finance and @accounting: please prepare a credit memo draft: amount = (12340 - 10120) * $0.0005 = $1.11 (token charge) + check support fee. Looks small but customer flagged as high priority.

Danny B: filing internal incident for mapping change process — will include timeline of mapping update on 2026-03-15 and impacted events.

Sophie L: thanks team. I'll reply to the customer with the plan: re-attribute, generate credit memo, and open GCP support case. Will provide ETA 48 hours. :thumbsup:
